# Bulk link creation

`POST /api/v1/urls/bulk` shortens up to 100 URLs in one request.

```bash
curl -X POST http://localhost:8000/api/v1/urls/bulk -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"items": [{"url": "https://example.com/a"}, {"url": "https://example.com/b", "custom_alias": "spring-b"}]}'
```

Response (200):

```json
{"created": 2, "failed": 0, "results": [
  {"index": 0, "ok": true, "link": {"code": "Ab3dE9x", "short_url": "...", "...": "..."}, "error": null},
  {"index": 1, "ok": true, "link": {"code": "spring-b", "...": "..."}, "error": null}]}
```

## Behaviour

- Items are processed independently: an invalid URL or a taken alias fails only that item.
- Every item consumes one rate-limit token; items over the limit fail with `rate limit exceeded`.
- 422 for an empty batch, more than 100 items, or unknown fields.

## Decision (ADR-002)

Partial success with HTTP 200 and per-item results. All-or-nothing would force clients to
pre-validate whole campaign files; 207 Multi-Status was rejected as WebDAV-specific.
